stance: Inflation is re-accelerating on two sources. September CPI: headline 0.649% m/m, 3.738% y/y; core 0.335% m/m, 2.564% y/y. September PPI, a CPI leader, is hotter: headline 1.343% m/m, 6.338% y/y; core 0.681% m/m, 4.978% y/y. Core PCE y/y at 2% is the Fed gauge, so cut expectations face pushback. Playbook: yields up, USD up, equities down. Would soften if ISM Prices Paid cools and core CPI m/m returns to 0.2% or below.
